newsitem.title: USA: Central Garden & Pet might offer notes.
newsitem.headline: Central Garden & Pet might offer notes.

text.p: Central Garden & Pet Co said it had proposed to offer in a private placement $100 million worth of convertible subordinated notes, plus up to an additional $15 million to cover possible over-allotments.
The company said it would use the proceeds to repay short- and long-term debt as well as potential acquisitions and general corporate purposes.
One of the acquisitions is the pending purchase of the U.S. and Canadian flea and tick business of Sandoz Agro Inc.
Central Garden & Pet Co distributes lawn, garden and pet supply products.
